title: Huddle: notifications service
blurb: Your first full day on the notifications team at a social app. Quiet hours to build, a rate limiter PR to review, a fan-out RFC to read, and phones are about to start buzzing far too much.
newHire: The candidate joined Huddle's notifications team (the service that sends push notifications for the Huddle social app) as a senior engineer this week, and today is their first full day of real work. They have the repo, the team's Slack, the issue tracker and the production logs. They are secondary on-call today, shadowed by Ravi.

tickets.title: Quiet hours
tickets.body: Our #1 reason for people turning notifications off in the app-store reviews: "Huddle buzzed me at 3 AM". People should be able to set quiet hours, and get a short summary in the morning instead of a stream of pushes.
requirements: setQuietHours(userId, { start, end }) sets a user's quiet hours. start and end are 24-hour "HH:MM" strings ("07:00", not "7:00"; "24:00" is invalid) and must differ; anything else throws RangeError. setQuietHours(userId, null) turns quiet hours off. An unknown user throws USER_NOT_FOUND. getUser(id).quiet shows the window, or null.
Quiet hours are in the user's local time: use their utcOffsetMinutes (UTC-5 is -300, UTC+5:30 is 330).
A window can cross midnight: 22:00 to 07:00 is quiet from 22:00 at night until 07:00 the next morning. The start minute is quiet; the end minute is not.

During quiet hours, post notifications are held instead of sent. heldCount(userId) is the number held. Held posts do not count towards the 5-per-hour rate limit. A queue redelivery of the same event (same id) is held only once.
Security alerts (type "security.alert") are always sent immediately, even during quiet hours.

deliverHeld() runs from a cron every minute. Each user who has held posts and is no longer in quiet hours gets ONE summary push per device, title "While you were away", body "N new notifications" ("1 new notification" for one), and their held posts are cleared. Nothing is sent to a user who is still in quiet hours.

do.text: Morning, and welcome! 👋 Your first ticket is **PING-231** (quiet hours): it's under Tickets, and Tomás owns it. The repo is under Code; `notifications.test.js` is what CI runs. The Pushly notes in Docs explain how sending and the queue work. Ask me anything.

Hey, welcome to the team! Quiet hours is my top ask this quarter: the 3 AM buzz is all over our app-store reviews. The client side is ready for **Thursday's release**, so I'd love the backend done this week. Ping me with any questions on the ticket.

Could someone review **PR #212**? It moves the push rate limiter off Redis into memory. Saves about 40% of our Redis ops, and the bot already approved. Would be great to merge before the infra cost review on Friday 🙂

🚨 **SEV-2 · INC-0519**: users are getting the **same push 3 to 5 times**. The `push_duplicate_rate` alert is at 18% (normally under 0.1%), and app-store reviews and support tickets are piling up ("my phone won't stop buzzing"). You're secondary on-call, so please take point on investigating. Prod logs are under Logs. I'm IC: tell me what you find and what you want to do.

Pushly's status page shows **degraded delivery in eu-west since 09:30** (elevated 503s). Looks like it's on their side. My plan: post on our status page that it's a third-party issue, open a ticket with Pushly, and wait for them to recover. I'll go ahead in ~10 min unless you see something different.
No objections, so I've posted: "Duplicate notifications are caused by an outage at our push provider." Ticket open with Pushly. Waiting on them.

Pushly marked their incident **resolved at 10:48**. Duplicates are **still at about 15%**, mostly on posts from big accounts. So it's not just them, and our status page is now wrong. What else could it be? I need a hypothesis from you.
Saw the page. I'm in an interview loop until ~11:30 but I'll check Slack between rounds. The "Pushly & the fanout queue" doc covers what happens when a send fails, worth a read.

texts: Status update? Support wants to know what to tell users.
I need an update for the status page: what do we know, and what's next?
Still with us? Leadership is asking in #exec. Even 'still investigating, next update in 15' helps.

do.text: Thanks. Marking INC-0519 resolved. Please post a short summary here for the postmortem: user impact, root cause, what's fixed or mitigated, and follow-ups with owners.
Hey, any chance you could look at #212 today? Infra cost review is Friday and I'd love to show the Redis savings 🙏

Thanks for handling the incident! Quick one: design wants two more things in **Thursday's release**: a **"Snooze for 1 hour"** button, and **separate quiet hours for DMs and for posts**. The app-store submission cutoff is **Wednesday 6 PM**. Doable? Please answer on PING-231 so it's on record.
I've written up the fan-out RFC for the Creators program (Docs → *RFC: Per-follower fan-out*). Please leave a comment before Thursday's design review, especially after this morning.
How's PING-231 looking for Thursday? Anything I should warn the mobile team about?
Heading out soon. Before you go, could you write a short **handoff** (Handoff in the sidebar): what's done, what's open, and what someone needs to pick up tomorrow. Solid first day 🙌
